messages:
Samir Patel: quick prelaunch sync — finalizing marketplace listing + joint GTM. Need confirmations on press embargo, SI docs, HW partner assets, and landing CTA. Who can confirm statuses?
Maya Chen: I can take press embargo. Draft embargo window set: Tue 09:00 PT for lift. PR draft in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example :eyes: Legal needs signoff by EOD Fri.
Riley Torres: SI integration docs ~90% done — adding final diagrams and callflows. Pinged SI PMs for test creds (they promised creds by Mon). Small snippet for test hook: `curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/integrations/test -H 'Authorization: Bearer testKey' -d '{"tenant":"test-000"}'`
Laura Kim: Hardware partner confirmed listing assets (logos + product shots). Will upload to S3 by tomorrow morning. Will add alt text and compliance notes. :white_check_mark:
Omar Haddad: Landing CTA options ready — A/B variants in Figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/xyz. Ops question: can we stagger region rollouts? prefer to cut DNS regionally.
PartnerOps Bot: Release Bot: staging deployment scheduled Sat 02:00 UTC. Canary flag set: `feature.marketplace.v1.staged=true`. Healthchecks will run at +5m and +30m.
Samir Patel: proposed announce cadence: 1) partner preview (Thu) 2) press embargo lift + blog (Tue 09:00 PT) 3) catalog + partner microsites live (Tue +2h). Fallback: if legal not green, delay blog by 24h and hold catalog. Owners: Maya (press/legal), Riley (SI), Laura (HW assets), Omar (landing/flags).
Maya Chen: legal mostly OK but partner X has a trademark question on their product name — escalating to partner legal now. If unresolved, we may need a wording tweak. :exclamation:
Riley Torres: SI test creds posted to the secure channel: `test-tenant-123 / tempKeyXYZ` — will rotate before prod push. Integration smoke: auth, webhook retry, and schema checks passing locally.
Laura Kim: uploading final assets now to s3://redwood-marketplace/partners/partner-x/. If you notice missing alt text ping me. :thumbsup:
Omar Haddad: I'll add feature flags per region and coordinate DNS cutover. Ops, can you confirm a Tue 10:30 PT cutover window? If not, propose alternative.
Samir Patel: thanks team. Please drop a quick ✅ in this thread when your item is complete so I can update the rollout doc: https://docs.redwood.com/marketplace-rollout. I'll compile a final runbook and dry-run checklist by Mon EOD.
